title: ochna ovalis
intro: Ochna ovalis, commonly known as Mickey Mouse plant, is a small evergreen shrub native to southern Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ochna ovalis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
